name: Ambush first strike
description: Combat change, a sub-option of BVR combat (add-on picker, Work in progress; on by default there). It also works without BVR combat. A ship that opens fire on a ship of an empire that has not detected it (by the stock visibility rules: not in the target empire's sensor or long-range scanner reach, not hidden by stealth) gets an ambush for its opening seconds (10 by default): shots that would miss turn into hits 35% of the time and every hit does 50% more damage. A ship that has not fired for 20 seconds opens a new ambush if it is still undetected. This rewards stealth, scouts and sensor range: the side that sees first, and is not seen, wins the opening exchange. AI ships that are ambushing, or that the enemy has not detected, count the threats against them lighter when they weigh withdrawing, so stealthy AI fleets stay in the fights they open. Every number is a parameter.

flags.name: ambushAI
flags.label: AI empires count an ambush when they weigh an attack
flags.description: Off: the AI weighs attacks as usual.
